decision: prefers-reduced-motion zeroes ALL transitions (0.01ms) instead of gentler-not-zero
why: Reveal never hides under RM (JS guard) and no content is gated behind opacity, so the nuke costs polish only; revisit if comprehension-aiding fades appear

decision: Bento TILE keeps hover lift on non-link sections
why: Brief signature move (annotated-record card language); flagged as affordance risk by motion+visual reviewers, accepted deliberately

decision: Bezel tilt: duration-500 + hover:duration-700 = 700ms settle-in on hover, 500ms release
why: CSS applies the target state's duration; matches motion spec (slow settle in, faster out); visual-critic 'inverted' verdict was against a misworded changelog line, not the code

decision: DOB select chevron is a data-URI SVG with hardcoded #5c7386 stroke
why: data-URI cannot carry a CSS var; dims slightly in dark mode, acceptable

decision: Landing hero teaser stack floats at 7-9s infinite (ambient layer)
why: Brand surface, MOTION dial 5; ambient != interaction motion; global reduced-motion block zeroes it (detector checks per-file and cannot see the global guard)

decision: Delta placeholder renders a typographic em dash for absent values
why: Data placeholder, not prose; standard tabular convention
Audit COLOR 6.6: primary was functionally ink, deleting every accent moment (hover:text-primary invisible). Arctic navy identity kept, chroma raised; white-on-primary ~10:1

decision: --default-transition-duration 200ms + --default-transition-timing-function var(--ease-house); buttons moved 500->200ms; Card/TILE lift stays 500
why: Kills the second de-facto motion system (~30 bare transition-colors sites at Tailwind defaults) and the laggy 500ms hover colors; press stays 150

decision: Four bespoke landing rgba(15,23,42) shadows collapsed into one --el-bezel token (themed, dark tinted rgba(3,10,20)); dark --el-* also tinted off pure black
why: Tokens-only rule; slate family was off the ink ramp and dead in dark mode
Token duplicated ink-subtle (#5b7080 vs #5c7386): a 3-step ramp that rendered as 2; lightening instead would fail AA on small meta text
